title: ipomoea pes-tigridis subvar. longibracteata
intro: Ipomoea pes-tigridis subvar. longibracteata, commonly known as the "Japanese morning glory", is a type of climbing vine native to East Asia, characterized by its heart-shaped leaves and trumpet-shaped flowers. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea pes-tigridis subvar. longibracteata include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which help to relieve coughs, reduce swelling, and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in developing new drugs.
